items.summary: Data App #2, a vibe-coded aerospace delivery cockpit with a runway view, a per-aircraft dossier panel, one-click supplier-delay tracing and a scenario room (fictional data). 4 reactions.

items.summary: "Astranova," a polished dark space-exploration dashboard with KPI cards, her first Data App, built on a ChatGPT-generated dataset and listed in the Community Data Apps gallery. 46 reactions, 5 comments.

items.summary: On NLT Live he built a Data App with Claude from a transcript of Andy Kriebel's tutorial, then restyled a European Sales dashboard as Windows 3.11 with one prompt. 24 reactions, 5 comments.

items.author: Jonathan Drummey, Enterprise Enablement for Tableau at Apple, Nov 17
items.summary: Says he isn't sure he'll "ever create another point & click Tableau dashboard"; joins a Tableau Studio and Data Apps LinkedIn Live on Nov 18 at 12:00 PM. 1 reaction, 1 comment.

items.author: Bold Batdorj, Tableau + AI automation lab, Nov 17
items.summary: Journey 05 of "Self-driving Tableau Desktop": a "which dashboard did my AI build?" test, where a 2-pixel gap gave the AI away, so he moved spacing, fill and padding into a card constructor. Next: rebuilding a dashboard from a picture. Video.
